threads.body: The langchain instrumentation previously only ran on py312/py313, but this change expands it to py310 and py314. Given the prior restriction, this risks running a package (or its dependencies) on unsupported interpreters, which can create CI instability. If langchain (or a pinned dependency set) requires >=3.12, keep this envlist aligned (e.g., `py3{12,14}-...-latest` and `py312-...-oldest`) while still dropping 3.11/3.13.
